# Material Dark

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-dark)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-dark)

Material Dark is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the Material family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-dark codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `materialDark` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { materialDark } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-material-dark';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, materialDark],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `materialDark` | `Extension` |
| `materialDarkMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#212121` |
| Active line | `#232426` |
| Selection | `#393939` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#fc7c6e` | bold | 6.32:1 | 6.10:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#fc7c6e` | bold | 6.32:1 | 6.10:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#bdbdbd` | - | 8.57:1 | 8.27:1 | 6.15:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#96a4b2` | - | 6.33:1 | 6.10:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#99d066` | - | 8.87:1 | 8.56:1 | 6.36:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#889dfa` | - | 6.33:1 | 6.10:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#56c8d8` | - | 8.17:1 | 7.88:1 | 5.86:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#de7cee` | - | 6.31:1 | 6.08:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#fc7c6e` | - | 6.32:1 | 6.10:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#facf4e` | italic | 10.81:1 | 10.43:1 | 7.75:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#889dfa` | italic | 6.33:1 | 6.10:1 | 4.54:1 |
| String | `string` | `#ffad42` | - | 8.67:1 | 8.37:1 | 6.22:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#fb789a` | - | 6.33:1 | 6.11:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#facf4e` | - | 10.81:1 | 10.43:1 | 7.75:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#fb7e57` | - | 6.31:1 | 6.08:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#99d066` | - | 8.87:1 | 8.56:1 | 6.36:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#96a4b2` | italic | 6.33:1 | 6.10:1 | 4.54:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#bdbdbd` | background, active line, selection | 6.15:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#96a4b2` | gutter | 6.21:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#a0a4ae` | background, active line | 6.23:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#56c8d8` | background | 8.17:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #56c8d8` | background, active line | 7.88:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#56c8d8, 1px solid #56c8d8` | background (fill or outline) | 8.17:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#ffffff1c` | active line | 1.35:1 | Pass |
